articles.title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
articles.description:
Rafaela hit a homer in Friday’s game, too.

The post Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs for the Red Sox on August 1.
Rafaela also homered in the previous game, showcasing his power.
His performance boosts excitement among Boston fans for the ongoing season.
